summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a US$225.0 million aggregate principal amount of 4.125% convertible senior notes due 2031, issued via private placement under Rule 144A. Net proceeds of ~US$215.9 million (after commissions but before capped call costs) will fund development of the Cariboo Gold Project and general corporate purposes. Initial purchasers have a 13-day option for an additional US$25.0 million; an affiliate committed US$50.0 million. The initial conversion price is ~US$3.68/share, a ~25% premium over the US$2.94 closing price on May 20, 2026. Capped calls offset dilution. This is a capital raise, not a special-situation event.
